notes.title: Platform Control on Steam!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to bring my mobile puzzle game to steam!
The game will launch with 50 levels and 6 platform types.
If the game will find some success and enough people will ask for it I might add steam workshop integration and a level editor in the future.
There are also skins and a skin drop system: a set of skins will drop once every 24 hours.
Oh and did I forget to mention? The game is FREE!

See you in game!
- YAGEL09
